post.topic: Instant Lead Follow‑Up for Real Estate Agents
post.headline: *Never* Lose a Lead Again
post.subline: Automate WhatsApp replies and email nudges to keep prospects engaged instantly
post.caption:
🚀 Stop losing hot property leads to slow replies! 
⏰ Problem: Real estate agents miss 30% of inquiries because they can’t reply instantly. 
✅ Fix: Set up an AI bot that auto‑responds on WhatsApp, sends a personalized email, and schedules a follow‑up call. 
💡 Today’s tip: Use a simple trigger – when a new message contains “price” or “tour”, send a ready‑made reply with a Calendly link. 
Save this post and share it with any agent who needs faster responses. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call
post.insight_note: Real estate agents are urgently seeking faster lead response solutions to stay competitive.
